batting.dismissal: c Abdul Samad b B Kumar

batting.name: SV Samson
batting.dismissal: c JO Holder b S Kaul

batting.name: LS Livingstone
batting.dismissal: c Abdul Samad b Rashid Khan

batting.name: R Parag
batting.dismissal: c JJ Roy b S Kaul

batting.name: JJ Roy
batting.dismissal: c SV Samson b C Sakariya

batting.name: WP Saha
batting.dismissal: st SV Samson b MK Lomror

balls.text: looks to slog-sweep that full just outside off but misses and is hit on his pads. The ball trickles to the off side, and they can only bag a leg-bye
dropped by Samad at deep square leg! This is a slower ball and short of a length on middle. Lomror pulls from deep in his crease and survives, as Samad takes his eyes off the ball

taken by Roy at long-off after going low to his right! Looked like there would be a near collision between him and Holder, who was running to his left with his eyes on the ball, but that is avoided. Parag tries to lift that full delivery in the slot on off, but only gets the height
slower ball, and yorker wide of off. Jammed toward point with a horizontal bat

lobs that to long-on! The bat turns in his hands as he tries to use his wrists and bottom hand to loft that over the leg side. But the ball is pretty full and just outside off for that shot, which means he doesn't have the room for a free swing of the arms despite standing deep in his crease and making room

Saha misses the direct hit at his end, and so Samson survives. He was pretty short of the crease and had given up too, as he ran in after Lomror missed his slog to this fullish ball wide of off which was also a slower ball
good stop by Saha to his right. He was going to his left after Bhuvi landed that yorker outside leg, with the ball taking Samson's front pad and rolling behind. Good bowling there
Saha dives to his right, but can't get a glove. Lomror goes across off to this very full ball on middle and leg, and looks to scoop but mistimes it
fullish but really wide of off. Lomror makes room, but that is still wide enough
low full-toss on off, and clipped to deep midwicket. Again a near-yorker

reverse-ramps that over short third man! Bhuvi bowls it near yorker length on off, but Samson lifts that above the fielder inside the circle. The ball is topped right at the last moment from crossing the fence
makes room, as Bhuvi follows him with a full ball outside leg too. Whipped to deep midwicket off his bottom hand
yorker right in the slot on middle. Samson brings his bat down to get an inside edge toward the on side, as they set off for a single
wide-ish ball outside off, and Lomror looks to slog across the line, but is beaten

dropped by Sandeep at short third man! Lomror looked to slice that fullish ball wide of off, but gets it off near the top edge as the ball balloons behind. Sandeep runs back and makes some ground, but the ball pops out his hand as he tries to grab at that
back of a length ball outside off, and it is a slower ball, with the ball coming into him. Pulls this to long-on on the bounce
full-toss wide of off, and he hammers that to deep extra cover away from his body. That is the 150 up now
lands that yorker right on middle and leg. Samson jams that back, as they rush for a single. Holder kicks it on to the stumps at the striker's end, but Lomror is in
pulls that to beat short fine leg! This is on a shortish length on leg, and Samson is deep in his crease to this back-of-the-hand ball and pulls to the left of the man inside the circle
starts with a slower ball that is on a fullish length on middle and leg. Slides down further, as Samson misses his pull with the ball passing under his bat. Wide called
goes short to Lomror again. He pulls this ball on middle, as the man at deep midwicket runs to his left but doesn't collect the ball cleanly after a slide. But that was two anyway
slower ball and a on a full length a touch wide of off. Slapped to deep point
short delivery on middle, and flat-bats that to long-on, as the man at long-off runs to his left to slide and stop that
yorker length and a touch wide of off. Drilled to short third man with a horizontal bat
goes inside-out over extra cover! Uses his wrists to club that good length ball wide of off between deep point and long-off. Very good placement
starts with a near yorker outside leg. Lomror makes room, and clips that to deep midwicket

clever bowling. This is short again, and a slower ball too. But that is just outside off, and climbing on to Samson too, who realises it is a bit high to have a go at and lets that go. Still, 20 off that over

cracks that over deep midwicket! Change of pace from Kaul again, but this is short on off, and that allows Samson the time to wait for it before rocking that pull for another six in the over. With that, he now has 3000 IPL runs
short delivery on off, and pulled to deep midwicket between the man there and Holder at long-on

six off a leading edge! Baffling to see that. That could never have been six. Kaul bowls a cutter on a full length outside leg, as Samson looks to clip, but gets a leading edge. The ball flies right back for six
bowls this short and just outside off. It is a slower ball at just 117kph, as Samson pulls to deep square leg. There is a fumble there, and that means Samson can bag an easy two

and Samson goes right over the man inside the circle at mid-off! Another fifty for Samson too. The ball is really full on middle and off, as he makes room and stays deep in his crease to loft that with the full face of the bat. Absolutely creams that
another wrong 'un. Samson punches this good length ball just outside off to long-on after allowing it to spin. So 11 from Rashid's last over
good length ball on middle, and this time turning into him. He flat-bats that toward long-on, as Rashid gives the chase behind
googly now, as he tickles this full ball on middle and leg behind to the right of short fine leg
back of a length ball on leg, and turning away from the left-hander. Pulled to deep square after clearing his front leg
again pretty full and just outside off. But this time Samson drives that to long-off from the full face of the bat
launched over long-off! Skips down to this full ball just outside off, which is turning a touch away from him. Samson makes room, and rams that into the stands
yorker, and just outside off. Clipped to deep square leg, as Samson gets that from the inside half of the bat
goes short again on middle. Lomror pulls that toward deep square leg
hoicked over long-on! That ball was right in the slot on off, as he hung deep in his crease to swing his bat full stretch and across the line for the maximum
slower ball, and a low, dipping full-toss on off. Clipped to long-on, as Holder goes at just 103kph
short delivery on middle, and with good bounce. Pulled to deep square leg with the bounce
full delivery on off, and that is pushed back to the bowler with the closed face of the bat
presents the full face of the bat to this full ball outside off, and bags a quick two. The man at cover dives to his left, but can't stop that
good length ball on middle, and turning in again. Wide down the leg side
the googly now! Full in length and just outside off, as Samson dabs at that with the turn into him
fuller and straighter on middle and off. Cut to deep point for a single
slogged just over midwicket! The man there leaped to his right, but doesn't get a hand. That was full and in the slot on middle, and he sweeps that forcefully
tosses this up to go very full on middle, as it is drilled to midwicket
tickles this full ball just outside off to short third man, where the fielder scampers to his left and slides to stop it
very full and wide of off. Another slower ball from Kaul. Lomror makes room and has a jab at that with a horizontal bat, but is beaten
fuller ball on middle and off, as he goes across to lap that to short fine leg. He was off for a run too, but the throw kept him in check
goes for the bouncer now, and it is called first bouncer. Short pf a length on middle, and close to the batter too. Lomror sways out of the way, and lets that go
slower ball on a full length on off at just 112kph. Chips it toward cover by opening the bat face, but safely so
clips this good length ball on middle to fine leg, with the ball angling in a touch

overthrow from Abhishek at the keeper's end, and that allows a single despite the ball hitting the stumps. The bat was in on time. Kaul starts with a good length ball on middle and off, as Lomror dabs that toward point from really close to his body
pretty full on middle again, and that is driven to long-on with the full face of the bat
flicks this fullish ball on off to deep square leg
goes to lap-sweep this full ball outside off, but gets it off his inside edge on to his pad, as the ball trickles to the off side
the wrong 'un. Good length ball on middle and turning away, as it dabbed back to the bowler
fuller ball and straighter on middle and off. Pushed to long-on

short delivery on middle, and pulled to fine leg! The fielder has to run forward a few steps after Livingstone goes deep in his crease to this short ball which is turning away from him a touch. But he gets that off this higher side of the bat, and sends that into Samad's hands
full on leg. Comes down the ground and muscles a shot to long on for a single
full on middle. Bit of extra bounce. Punched off the back foot through point to the deep
full on middle. Goes onto the back foot and works it to deep midwicket
full on leg. Skidding into his pads. Misses the flick. Hits the boot and rolls away to short fine leg
full on middle. Samson backs away, exposing the stumps, and then shovels an inside-out loft past long off for four! Hits it between long off and extra cover
full outside off from around the stumps. Pushed down the ground to long off for one
full on off. He comes down the ground and firmly drives to long on for one
good length just outside off. Worked away to point off the back foot

chopped on next ball! Continues around the wicket and attempts a full-pitched ball. Jaiswal comes down the track to attack it but it's dipping as he meets it on the full toss, and it takes the inside edge onto the stumps
around the stumps but that helps Jaiswal. Length ball on off and angling into middle. Jaiswal moves back, exposing all three stumps, and then swats the ball over Sharma's head for a six over long off
aims for the yorker. Ends up as a low full toss on middle and leg. Clipped off his pads to deep midwicket. Samson may be disappointed playing it towards the only leg-side fielder in the deep
back with a yorker first ball. Lands just in front of off. Dug back, played carefully
back of a length on middle, and he mistimes the cut. Finds point. Partnership still on 49
slower ball, back of a length outside off. Nudged late to third man for a single
good length ball outside off. Shuffles across to play a guided pull towards fine leg but the ball goes over his shoulder to the keeper
full toss on leg stump. Tries to flick it fine. But hits the hip and rolls away leg side
back of a length on off. Angling across. Jaiswal muscles a cut along the ground to deep extra cover
full on off from Holder after the break. Nudged off the front foot to deep backward square leg
good length on middle. Skiddy ball turning towards off. Jaiswal shuffles to the leg side to play the late cut, and gets some bat on it to find the gap next to short third man! Time out
just outside off stump. Googly turning in and punched to long on for a single
full on middle, and reverse swept past point's right. Sharma in the deep has to run to his left to cut it off
fullish outside off. Turning away. Samson presses forward to defend. Past the edge!
good length on middle. Turning across past off. He rocks back and flat-bats a shot to deep midwicket
full outside leg stump. Tries to flick, but too slow to play. Hits the pad and rolls away
slower ball to end the powerplay. Good length on off, and he nudges it to the off side for a quick single
full toss on his waist, and flicked behind square. Nearly carries to Rashid Khan! Is that a no-ball for height? No
good length ball on middle. Slower one too. ANgling down leg but hits Samson's hips on the way to Saha
good length ball just outside off. But Samson waits for it, and cuts it as the ball is under his eyes. Beats point, and runs away for four more
full outside off. Moving away. Lazy elegance as he presses forward and thumps a four through cover!
first ball for Sid Kaul in the UAE leg of IPL 2021. Full on leg stump, and he flicks it easily off his toes to deep backward square leg
yorker length coming into leg stump. Dug away to mid on
wide ball but full. Toe-ends a cut to deep point for another single
good length on leg and the pull is in the air (as it has come to be with Jaiswal.) But falls a few feet short of deep backward square
full outside off stump. Gets the bat out and taps it past point to the man in the deep
another pull that lands safely. Good length on leg, and he mistimes the shot again. Nobody at square leg, so safe
good length, just outside off. Cuts, but hit fine. Short third man cuts it off

just over Holder! If he can't get there, nobody can. Or maybe they could've? Holder backtracks very slowly from mid on and the ball goes just past his fingertips as he puts one hand out to take the catch. Length ball on middle, and the pulled shot is sliced in the air.
back of a length just outside leg stump. Jaiswal spots the poor length and looks to hook it over square leg. Plays it finer since it comes off the glove....past short fine leg for four more
length ball angling into middle and leg. Flicked to deep midwicket for a jogging single

good length outside off. Another wide ball, and cut in front of square. Cover drive - Samad - runs to his right to dive and stop. Garg picks up and throws at the bowler's end for the run-out. But not a direct hit
short and wide. Samson doesn't need a second invitation. Reaches out, cuts it so that the ball doesn't go in the air. Gets the gap between point and cover
tidy line. Good length on middle, and he nudges this to third man for a single
good length, outside off again. Cut to the fielder in the deep on the off side
good length just outside leg. He walks down the ground and then lofts a flicky shot over midwicket. Nobody there to stop that!
full outside off stump. Presses forward to drive, but the ball goes past the outside edge to the wicketkeeper
good length, outside off. Bends his knees and slaps a cut past point's left! Races away to the boundary
fullish outside off stump. One hand goes off the bat as he tries to punch behind square. Ball rolls away to point
good length on off, and punched through to deep extra cover
length ball angling in, and worked of his hips to midwicket. Diving effort, stops the single, and also gives Bhuvneshwar a wicket maiden
another one just past the outside edge. Full just outside off stump. Presses forward to defend, but through to the keeper
shuffles across to the off side and fends it away to cover point
this one's outside off and no shot offered
good length just outside off. Seaming away as Samson tentatively brings the bat out. Past the outside edge

length ball, on leg stump, and that's worked just as SRH planned! Swivels to whips one off his waist to find fine leg, but it's gone squarer... and taken by Samad at deep backward square. Lewis played a similar shot last over but that was along the ground. This one was up in the air
full on leg. Wants to flick it over midwicket but a leading edge takes it over point instead! Lucky for Jaiswal, Royals get 11 off the first.
comes down the ground. But can't get bat on ball. Fullish on middle, and he comes down the track to go over cover. But misses as the ball swings away and past off stump
good length, on leg stump. Whips this shot to fine leg. Deep backward square runs around to cut it off
first boundary! Length ball outside off, and he cuts it behind square. Past point's right for four
good length on middle. Seam movement across, and he nudges this gently past first slip to third man
full on middle, and driven off the front foot. To mid off's right

and hoicked to deep midwicket again. Sunrisers win just their second match, and that is Williamson's fifty too! That was bowled in the slot on off, and he whacked that across the line to go over the man inside the circle and bisect long-on and deep square
low full-toss on off, and whipped to deep midwicket! The fielder at midwicket goes low to his left to try and stop that, but in vain. Absolute timing there, not much power
drills this drive to the man at cover. Mustafizur bowls a slower ball on a full length outside off, as Williamson can't beat the fielder
crunched to deep point. That was pretty full and just outside off, and Williamson leant into the drive
another short delivery, and is called wide. Pitches on leg, and Williamson, who is deep in his crease, lets that pass after bending down
whips that to long leg! A short delivery on leg, as he stays across a touch to this slower ball, and finds the gap between fine leg and deep square leg
whips this full ball on off across the line to fine leg. Goes low to flick that slightly away from his body
full and very wide of off. He lets that go, and it is called wide
overthrow, and a run conceded! Short length ball on off, as he rides the bounce to push that to cover, from where Morris throws back at the striker's end, only to send that for an extra run
back of a length ball outside off, and he punches to point, where a fumble allows a single
makes a pleasing sound off the bat! Right in the slot on off, and he swings his arms to deposit that deep into the stands over long-on after clearing his front leg

A mix-up, and an appeal for run-out! But Williamson is dragging his bat back into the crease at the keeper's end as Samson clips the bails. It was a full-toss on off, which Abhishek clipped to deep midwicket. The initial call seemed to be for two, as the fielder was quick to intercept. Williamson also slipped a bit, before turning back and returning home safely
pretty full and straight on middle. Angles away a touch after pitching on leg, as Williamson presents the full face of the bat to push that to long-off
another slower ball. This is on a driving length just outside off, but Williamson finds the man at cover with his drive
wide delivery. Change of pace on a good length outside leg, as Williamson looks to clip that but misses
full-toss on middle, which is angling. Clipped to fine leg from deep in his crease
fuller and just outside off. He opens the bat face to run that to point, but that is another dot
pushes that at aerially, and that was close to the bowler! Another change of pace ball on a good length on off, and he simply jabs back at that. Lucky that landed safely
good length ball just outside off. He is standing across off, as he pushes that to deep midwicket for another quick two
very full and just outside leg. The ball flies after pitching, as Samson can't get a glove after trying to leap first, but then giving up. Replays show that flicked the pad
shortish ball and just outside off, pulled to deep square's right. Immediate call of two, as one of the Royals players shouts "keeper, keeper" for the direction of the throw
Williamson comes down, as Sakariya lands that yorker length on middle and off. Jammed to deep point with a flat bat
short delivery pitching on leg, and Williamson ducks underneath. First bouncer called
bowls slower and pretty full just outside off. That was angling in, as Williamson tapped that point
looks to loft that straight down, but gets the outside edge to third man, as Sakariya goes full and just outside off in the driving length
he makes room, as Morris goes on a good length on middle, and Abhishek cuts that to deep point
caresses this drive to deep point, as this is again full and just outside off. Good, leaning drive
gets an inside edge on to his front pad, as Williamson drives at this full ball outside off. Morris runs forward to stop that
slower ball on a fuller length on his pads, as it is flicked to fine leg after almost falling over
Morris goes short, and Abhishek pulls that to long leg! That was pitched on middle and leg, as he pulled with a swivel and with his front leg in the air
good length ball on off, and he taps that to point from close to his body
good length ball and wide of off. Cuts this to deep point unconvincingly
now a slower ball to Abhishek too. Full and on off, he opens the bat face to dab that to point
continues bowling change of pace to Williamson. This is again full and a touch outside leg, as he clips that to deep midwicket after moving across a touch
punches this good length ball just outside off to deep point, as he drives with the full face of the bat
fullish length and a touch wide of off. Dabs that late to third man
change of pace on a very full length on off. Pushed back to the bowler, who stretches out his right hand, as the ball drops out after striking it
bouncer on leg, and that is too high! Wide called. Williamson thinks about pulling, but lets that go since that was really high

lobbed back, and gone! Mustafizur bowls a slower ball again, as this is an offcutter on a full length on middle and leg. Garg presents the full face of the bat, but can only chip that back to the bowler, who goes low and across to his right to complete the take. Any twists awaiting us maybe?
another slower ball, but this is fuller and just outside leg. Clipped toward deep square leg
slower ball on a good length on leg, which is angling away. Dabbed toward square leg, as Mustafizur runs forward to collect that back
chipped, but safely beats mid-off! Opens the bat face to this full ball on middle and off, and also clears his front leg. That just clears mid-off to his left
slower ball and pretty full on leg. Williamson taps that back toward the off side
full delivery in the driving length just outside off. Driven to cover, where the fielder dives to his right to stop that

Looks to scoop but ends up playing it too fine. The umpire asks Roy to wait even though Sakariya is already off in celebration and Roy is also walking back. A good take by Samson too, tumbling to his left and clutching at it. That was a slower one, on a length around leg stump, Roy looked to scoop that over after going a touch across, but only got a tickle. A commanding innings comes to an end
now Roy goes flashing away from his body. That is again on a good length on off, and angling away as Roy has a go, but doesn't get on ball
slower ball on a full length on middle. Williamson waits for it come, before pushing that to long-on
goes to cut that short and wide ball outside off, but is beaten. Samson appeals for caught behind, but he is the only one excited
slower ball on a fullish length on his pads. Clipped to fine leg after opening himself up a touch
outside edge, and slashed to third man. Sakariya goes fullish and wide of off, as Williamson looks to cut but gets it off the edge
bisects short third man and point with his reverse-sweep! Goes low early to this full on off, and rolls his wrists over for another boundary in the over. That makes it 21 off Tewatia
dropped by Jaiswal at extra cover! That was slashed hard off a driving length outside off, as Jaiswal goes low to his left and spills the chance
another wide. Full and wide of off, and spinning in now, but still wide, with Roy's back leg outside off too
sweeps that between dep midwicket and long-on! Fetches that full ball from outside off, and finds the gap this time
fullish and wide of off. Leaves that alone for a wide
swept to fine leg for his fifty! This is shorter in length on middle and off, as he is slightly across off to push that to the left of the fielder there
slog-sweeps that miles over deep square leg! That is in the slot on a full length on middle, and he has a full swing of the arms after going on his knee
good length ball on middle, and punched down to long-on
good length on off. Worked to midwicket, and there's a gap for the single

good length just outside off. He rocks back and beautifully chips a punchy shot over wide long off for six! Williamson's bat was like a conductor's rod there. Elegance, and Morris at long off failed to take a catch as well
full just outside leg stump. Clears the front leg and thumps it to long on for one. Wanted to go for a bigger shot but ends up mistiming it
good length outside off. Slapped to cover off the back foot
fullish, on middle. Punched to long on off the back foot for a single
good length outside off. Punched to mid off's right
full and wide outside off stump. Makes further room and slaps a mistimed lofted shot over cover. Rolling away to wide long off for four, but the outfielder stops the boundary
full outside off. Looks to defend to the off side. Takes an inside edge to the leg side instead
full outside off. He goes to the off side and mistimes a sweep to deep backward square leg
good length just outside off. Uses his wrists to hit an inside out drive. Stopped at cover
full on off stump. Turning away. He rocks back and punches it firmly past the non-striker to long on for a jogging single
good length on middle. Punched with the open stance to wide long on for a single
full on middle. Gets outside the line of the ball and drives to long off
good length on middle. Nudged off his pas to midwicket
length ball on off and angling into middle and leg. Punched to mid on's right
length ball outside off. Turning away. Cuts it to Lewis at deep extra cover, giving the duo another chance for a double
good length on off stump. Goes onto the back foot and flicks to long on's right for a couple
fullish outside off and angling into off. Cut behind square to deep point
full outside off stump. Driven inside out to long off once more
full, wider outside off. Waits, waits and waits before playing a late cut past Samson's right leg. Short third man intercepts
full outside off stump. Slaps a swatted drive to wide long off for one
full on leg. Gets the bat in front of the pad and nudges it to midwicket's right for one
good length on middle, and angling into leg. Flicked to deep midwicket
full outside off from over the wicket. Too close to his body for the cut but goes for it anyway. Squirted to point
full outside off. Drags a sloggy shot over the non-striker to long on. Just six off it and Sunrisers made 63 in the powerplay
good length, outside off stump. Cuts in front of square, where Parag gets behind it
good length outside off stump. Punched off the back foot to long off for a single
good length, outside off stump. Backs away,  and flat-bats a shot to mid off
full and wide outside off. Bit of turn away. He drives off the front foot, and Sakariya at cover point ends up diving over it! What should've been one ends up as a four

around the stumps. And gets Saha first ball. He will be disappointed falling this way. Saha skips down the ground to this full ball outside off, but it stays low. Saha misses the slog over midwicket, and is slow to get inside the stumps while Samson pulls off the stumping

full on off stump. Looks to place a flick over midwicket. But toe-ends the shot, and is lucky that it goes just over midwicket. The pace increases along the ground, and deep square leg running around can't stop the four either
waist-high full toss on middle and leg. Looks to flick it off his waist, and gets some bat en route to fine leg for four more! Played very fine, and Roy is roaring now

slower ball yorker, just outside leg. He looks to roll his wrists to guide a flick fine but misses. However Roy wouldn't mind since that hits his boot and goes past Samson diving to his left. More runs
good length outside off. Throws his bat at it, and maximises the width offered by placing the cut between point and short third man! Lots of boundaries coming
fullish, just outside off stump. Mistimed cut, but finds backward point
good length outside off. Uses his wrists to cut it behind point. Livingstone has to run and slide from deep point to intercept
good length, on off. Flat-batted slap to cover

full outside off. He looks to clobber a shot over wide long off but ends up slicing it to deep extra cover instead. He'll take that, although there was a fielder at deep point that he should be careful of

full on off. The cutter loses pace after pitching, and Roy can't play any shot. On the bounce to Samson, and an awkward bounce makes the keeper misfield. Ball goes through his legs, and goes away for four byes! Disastrous
back of a length, outside leg stump. Waits for the ball to get to him before gently paddling a scoop over short fine leg
full in the slot. Drills a drive by coming down the ground. Has four written all over it but Morris moves swiftly to his right from mid off to intercept
fullish, cutter angling away. Smothers a drive to cover
fullish outside off. Sticks the bat out and taps it to cover point
good length outside off. Stands tall, and cuts in front of square to extra cover for four!
full on off stump. Slapping it to mid off for a single. Throws to break the stumps at the bowler's end but Unadkat is not behind the stumps. Stopped by the fielder backing up
good length on middle. Mistimed pull to deep backward square leg
full on off. Presses forward into a front-foot drive. Cover stops it
lovely sound as this length ball on middle is put away with disdain! Meets the ball for a pull while it was still rising. Struck in front of square
full on middle. Raises his back leg while flicking through the leg side. Mistimed. Midwicket gets behind it
back of a length outside off. Stands tall and plays inside out through cover's right. Jaiswal runs to the boundary line and dives over the ball to drag it right back in
good length on off. Worked off his waist to square leg for a single
back of a length slower ball outside off. Rolls his wrists over the pull. Played along the ground to the deep
full on leg. Comes down the ground and bunts it to mid on for a single
full outside off, and a bit of away movement. Driven to cover, but stopped by the fielder
full just outside off. Clears the front leg and hammers a slog over midwicket. Enough in it to beat the infield. Races away for the first four of the innings
full on middle, and the straight drive flies towards cover instead. A couple of bounces en route to Jaiswal
good length on middle. Rolls his fingers over the ball. Nudges it to the right of short third man, but stopped by Sakariya's dive
good length outside off. Stands tall and punches through cover to the fielder in the deep
full and wide outside of. Angling further away. Is it over the tramlines? Umpire thinks so...wide given.
fullish on off. Defended to the off side with soft hands, and they go for a quick single
good length on off and angling across. Roy walks into a shot but then nudges it late to short third man
